newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,150 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,150 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 1,150 contracts compared with 316 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 43 wheat, 197 corn, 631 soybean, 163 soymeal, 90 soyoil, three rice, 16 corn call, four soybean call ad three soybean put contracts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 1/4 cent lower, corn was 1/2 to 1-1/4 cents lower and soybeans were 1-1/4 to two cents lower.
